venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Saturday 10/31 (MOD JK; entered by Daniel; posted 3:18am 11/1)** Net $8,378 vs target $8,646 (97%). Food $542, comps $71, 292 guests / $28.69 avg. Happy Halloween: slow start, huge pop around 11 as guests arrived from Halloween parties in costume. Full staff, staff costume Addams Family. Guests watched the Atlanta Dream playoff game. Last call 1:30am (2:30 after time change), out by 2am. 86 Espolon. No incidents. Favorite moment: bachelorette party in costume enjoying shots.

venues.name: CC Nashville

venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Saturday 10/31 (MOD KE/MD & JMS/DM; entered by JO; posted 4:02am 11/1)** Net $16,249 vs target $9,381 (173%). Food $451, comps $167.19 (1.0%), ~590 guests / $27.54 avg. Very successful Halloween: only ~$1k by 7pm, then got rocked from 9:30pm; peak 10:30pm-12:30am, extra hour from time change. Kala hosted costume awards on house mic. Team in Where's Waldo attire. Danny's last night in kitchen. 86 MHL Ponies. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Saturday 10/31 (AM Maggie H / Evan & Josh; PM Carey & Lucas; entered by Carey; posted 3:48am 11/1)** Net incl. events $31,774.07 vs target $15,889 (200%). Venue net $11,310.07 (DC/AM $1,781.39; D&C PM $9,528.68); Net event sales $20,464; total food incl. events $14,014.95 (venue food $2,012.95, event food $12,002). Comps $371.05 (3.28%), 313 guests (Tock). Halloween wedding for Erika & Charles, 79 guests 5pm-10pm in all spaces, family-style dinner, event team praised. Evening a roller coaster of busy/slow waves; busy lobby at report time. Still no bar mix. An injury/incident was flagged on the form (details not provided).

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Saturday 10/31 (MOD/Chef Kyler & Michael; entered by Thomas; posted 2:26am 11/1)** Net $8,506 vs target $7,730 (110%). Food $988, beverage $7,518, comps $305.66, 224 guests / $38 avg. Strong start (~80% room), fallow, then refilled periodically; experiences ran long with several mid-size parties near 2 hours. 6 large parties, 6 solos, 10 investor cocktails. Top sellers: Native Lion, Rosalie, High Plains Drifter. Door: solid aside from lulls until 9, then constant until ~1am; many groups too large to accommodate. Glassware breakage 1 SOF, 1 DOF.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Saturday 10/31 (MOD Gigi + Julian + Joe/Josh + Saleh + Angel; entered by Joe; posted 5:46am 11/1)** Net $15,263 vs target $13,666 (112%). Food $3,003, Standing Room $4,621, Marquee $10,642, comps $279, 395 guests / $83.86 avg. One of the busiest Saturdays of the year: started with 132 covers, Marquee full by 7pm, standing room strong until 1am. Ran skeleton crew (one server, one host); Enoch back training with Mia. 86 cookies (oven not heating properly). No incidents; no-shows charged.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Saturday 10/31 (MOD Josh; posted 11:06am 11/1, late submission)** Net (incl. events) $5,920.09 vs target $9,746 (61%). Marquee bar $5,869.71, Garden $130, food $704.20, comps $79.62 + voids $32, 160 guests, GCA $37.71. Very light Halloween: Garden extremely quiet and closed at 10:30pm to focus on Marquee; nice walk-in pop ~11:15pm (groups of 3-5). Service smooth, ample staff. Kitchen slow, mostly small shared plates. Maintenance: curtains. Takeaway: plan ahead for Halloween. No incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Saturday 10/31 (AM Sam & Lex/Shannon; PM Justin & Shannon/Marcus/Drew; entered by Alexis; posted 1:27am 11/1)** Net $16,976 vs target $16,184 (105%). Food $4,701, comps $630, 424 guests (124 AM + 300 PM, OpenTable) / $40.04 avg. Municipal Bar AM $2,370, PM $9,924, Sun Club $193 (last day of service), Hot Eye $4,508. Quiet brunch; strong happy hour between films; biggest walk-in push after the 9:30 film let out, busiest close in a long time. Sold out souvenir cups; last day of Film Fest $25 vouchers. Hot Eye slow first two hours then packed 3 hours once Brother started. Hot Eye bathrooms/floors need attention. No incidents.

venues.weather: High 54, mostly sunny, low 40s in the evening
venues.narrative: **SEA — Saturday 10/31 (MOD Curtis Hayes; entered by Curtis Hayes; posted 3:13am 11/1)** Net $10,854 vs target $11,640 (93%).
